proof_scope: Calendly public metadata generation, capacity-hold planning, real-calendar write fail-closed behavior, release receipt validation, and secret-write fail-closed behavior

claims.proves: the skill can generate validated public calendly.json metadata from fixture API payloads, plan real current-week capacity holds without writing calendars, reject hold ratios above 45 percent, keep capacity-hold execution and release dry-run by default, fail closed without Google OAuth, and keep GitHub secret writes dry-run by default
claims.does_not_prove: live Calendly API connectivity, GitHub secret mutation, successful Google Calendar busy-block writes, or successful release deletes

cases.name: fixture-site-metadata-public-and-validated
command: out="$(mktemp -d)/calendly.json"; ../run.sh generate-site-metadata --fixture-me sample_user_me.json --fixture-event-types sample_event_types.json --out "$out" | jq -e '.status=="WROTE" and .generatedFromApi==false and .seam_validation.status=="PASS"' >/dev/null && jq -e '.primarySchedulingUrl=="https://calendly.com/graham-anderson/intro-call" and .seam_validation.status=="PASS" and (.eventTypes|length)==2' "$out" >/dev/null && echo PASS_PUBLIC_METADATA

cases.name: capacity-holds-plan-dry-run-45-percent
command: ../run.sh capacity-holds plan --week current --today 2026-08-24 --target-ratio 0.45 | jq -e '.schema=="ops_calendly.capacity_holds.plan.v1" and .writesCalendar==false and .policy=="real_capacity_holds_only" and .disallowedUse=="fake_scarcity" and .targetRatio==0.45 and .plannedHoldCount==15' >/dev/null && echo PASS_CAPACITY_HOLDS_DRY_RUN

cases.name: capacity-holds-ratio-above-policy-rejected
command: tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; set +e; ../run.sh capacity-holds plan --week current --today 2026-08-24 --target-ratio 0.46 >"$tmp/out.json" 2>"$tmp/err.txt"; rc=$?; set -e; test $rc -ne 0 && grep -q '0.45' "$tmp/err.txt" && echo PASS_RATIO_REJECTED

cases.name: capacity-holds-execute-dry-run-by-default
command: out="$(mktemp -d)/write.json"; ../run.sh capacity-holds execute --week current --today 2026-08-24 --target-ratio 0.45 --receipt-out "$out" | jq -e '.schema=="ops_calendly.capacity_holds.write.v1" and .status=="NOT_EXECUTED" and .writesCalendar==false and .execute==false and (.createdEvents|length)==0' >/dev/null && test ! -e "$out" && echo PASS_EXECUTE_DRY_RUN

cases.name: capacity-holds-execute-fails-closed-without-google-oauth
command: tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; set +e; OPS_GCAL_CONFIG_DIR="$tmp/empty-gcal" ../run.sh capacity-holds execute --week current --today 2026-08-24 --target-ratio 0.45 --receipt-out "$tmp/write.json" --execute >"$tmp/receipt.json"; rc=$?; set -e; test $rc -eq 1 && jq -e '.status=="BLOCKED_UNAUTHENTICATED" and .writesCalendar==false' "$tmp/receipt.json" >/dev/null && echo PASS_EXECUTE_FAILS_CLOSED

cases.name: capacity-holds-release-dry-run-from-receipt
command: ../run.sh capacity-holds release --receipt sample_capacity_holds_write_receipt.json | jq -e '.schema=="ops_calendly.capacity_holds.release.v1" and .status=="NOT_EXECUTED" and .writesCalendar==false and .wouldDeleteCount==1' >/dev/null && echo PASS_RELEASE_DRY_RUN

cases.name: github-secret-is-dry-run-without-execute
command: ../run.sh github-secret --repo grahama1970/agent-skills | jq -e '.status=="DRY_RUN" and .execute==false and .secret=="CALENDLY_PAT"' >/dev/null && echo PASS_SECRET_DRY_RUN
